result.instructions: Tools for Scalingo, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Scalingo data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run scalingo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run scalingo_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run scalingo_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. scalingo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.title: List apps
tools.description: List all Scalingo apps you can access in the current region. Scalingo API: GET /v1/apps. Returns { apps: [...] }.

tools.name: get_app
tools.title: Get an app
tools.description: Fetch a single app's details (region, stack, status, URLs, flags). Scalingo API: GET /v1/apps/{app}. Returns { app }.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

tools.name: list_containers
tools.title: List containers (formation)
tools.description: List an app's container formation — the running process types with their amount and size (the current scaling). Scalingo API: GET /v1/apps/{app}/containers. Returns { containers: [{ name, amount, size }] }.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

tools.name: get_app_stats
tools.title: Get container stats
tools.description: Real-time per-container resource stats (CPU / memory / swap usage) for an app. Scalingo API: GET /v1/apps/{app}/stats. Returns { stats: [...] }.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.title: List deployments
tools.description: List an app's deployments (most recent first), paginated. Scalingo API: GET /v1/apps/{app}/deployments. Returns { deployments: [...], meta: { pagination } }.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

tools.name: get_deployment
tools.title: Get a deployment
tools.description: Fetch a single deployment's details (status, git_ref, pusher, image size, timestamps). Scalingo API: GET /v1/apps/{app}/deployments/{deployment_id}. Returns { deployment }.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

tools.name: get_app_logs
tools.title: Get recent app logs
tools.description: Fetch recent application log lines. Scalingo returns an authenticated logs_url (GET /v1/apps/{app}/logs → { logs_url }); this tool then downloads the last N lines from it (dump mode) and returns them as text. Returns { logs_url, lines }. If the follow-up download fails, only logs_url is returned so you can fetch it yourself.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

lines.description: Number of recent log lines to fetch (1-1000, default 100).

tools.name: list_variables
tools.title: List environment variables
tools.description: List an app's environment variables. WARNING: this exposes secret VALUES (API keys, database URLs, etc.). Scalingo API: GET /v1/apps/{app}/variables. Returns { variables: [{ id, name, value }] }.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

tools.name: list_collaborators
tools.title: List collaborators
tools.description: List an app's collaborators (users invited to the app) and their status. Scalingo API: GET /v1/apps/{app}/collaborators. Returns { collaborators: [...] }.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

tools.name: list_domains
tools.title: List domains
tools.description: List an app's custom domains and their TLS/canonical status. Scalingo API: GET /v1/apps/{app}/domains. Returns { domains: [...] }.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

tools.name: list_addons
tools.title: List addons
tools.description: List the addons (databases, services) provisioned on an app. Scalingo API: GET /v1/apps/{app}/addons. Returns { addons: [...] }.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

tools.name: list_addon_providers
tools.title: List addon providers
tools.description: List the addon providers available on Scalingo (databases, monitoring, etc.) with their plans embedded. Scalingo API: GET /v1/addon_providers. Returns { addon_providers: [{ ..., plans: [...] }] }.

category_id.description: Optional category id to filter providers.

tools.name: list_app_events
tools.title: List app events
tools.description: List an app's activity events (deployments, scaling, restarts, collaborator changes, etc.), paginated. Scalingo API: GET /v1/apps/{app}/events. Returns { events: [...], meta: { pagination } }.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

from.description: Restrict to events from the last N hours (1-72).

tools.name: get_operation
tools.title: Get an operation
tools.description: Poll the status of an asynchronous operation (e.g. a scale or restart returns an operation to track). Scalingo API: GET /v1/apps/{app}/operations/{operation_id}. Returns { operation } with status pending|running|done|error.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

operation_id.description: The operation id (returned in the Location header of a scale/restart response).

tools.name: list_regions
tools.title: List regions
tools.description: List the Scalingo regions available to your account, each with its API/dashboard/database hosts. Useful to discover the right SCALINGO_REGION. Scalingo API: GET (auth host) /v1/regions. Returns { regions: [...] }.

tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Get current account
tools.description: Fetch the authenticated user's account (id, email, username, fullname, company). Scalingo API: GET /v1/users/self. Returns { user }.

tools.name: scalingo_request
tools.title: Raw read request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any Scalingo API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Path is taken after /v1 (e.g. "/apps/my-app/alerts"). By default hits the regional API; set on_auth_host:true for auth-host resources (regions, scm_integrations, tokens). Scalingo API: GET {path}.

path.description: API path after /v1, starting with a slash, e.g. "/apps/my-app/notifiers".

on_auth_host.description: If true, target the auth host (auth.scalingo.com) instead of the regional API.

tools.name: restart_app
tools.title: Restart app
tools.description: MUTATES Scalingo infrastructure — restarts an app's containers. Optionally restart only specific process types via scope; omit scope to restart everything. Returns 202 Accepted (track via get_operation). Scalingo API: POST /v1/apps/{app}/restart.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

scope.description: Container types to restart, e.g. ["web","worker"]. Omit to restart all.

tools.name: scale_app
tools.title: Scale app
tools.description: MUTATES Scalingo infrastructure — sets the container formation (number and/or size of each process type). Only the container types you include are changed. Returns 202 Accepted (track via get_operation). Scalingo API: POST /v1/apps/{app}/scale.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

amount.description: Number of containers of this type.

containers.description: Formation entries to apply. Each entry needs a name plus amount and/or size.

tools.name: set_variables
tools.title: Set environment variables (bulk)
tools.description: MUTATES Scalingo infrastructure — creates or updates environment variables in bulk (each { name, value } is created if new or updated if it exists). This usually triggers a restart to apply the new env. Names ≤64 chars, values ≤8192 chars. Scalingo API: PUT /v1/apps/{app}/variables. Returns { variables }.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

tools.name: trigger_deployment
tools.title: Trigger a deployment
tools.description: MUTATES Scalingo infrastructure — triggers a new deployment from a source archive URL (a tar.gz reachable by Scalingo). To roll back, re-deploy a previous git_ref/archive — there is no separate rollback endpoint. Scalingo API: POST /v1/apps/{app}/deployments. Returns { deployment }.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

source_url.description: URL of the source archive (tar.gz) Scalingo should build and deploy.

git_ref.description: Optional git reference label for the deployment (branch/tag/SHA).
